beginner.title: Get started with YNAB
beginner.outcome: You can: set up YNAB, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Get paid
beginner.outcome: You can: send invoices or payment links
beginner.practice: Send a test invoice or payment link

beginner.title: Keep records straight
beginner.outcome: You can: record income and expenses

intermediate.title: Reconcile
intermediate.outcome: You can: match records to the bank

intermediate.title: Security and fraud
intermediate.outcome: You can: protect money and accounts
intermediate.practice: Review security settings and user roles

intermediate.title: Signature skills in YNAB
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make YNAB distinctive
topics: giving every unit of money a job
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced YNAB
expert.outcome: You can: use YNAB's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Reporting and integration
expert.outcome: You can: connect payments to accounting and reports
expert.practice: Connect YNAB to your books or a sheet

expert.title: Integrate YNAB into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect YNAB with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect YNAB to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use YNAB well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use YNAB" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
